title: Ardent Polish Buckwheat Bake
description: Spicy, bouncy-qq macrobiotic buckwheat bake infused with fresh perilla-leaf kkaennip.
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine buckwheat flour, salt, pepper, and chili flakes.
Whisk in water until batter is smooth and thick.
Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté garlic and ginger until fragrant.
Add the shredded perilla leaf kkaennip and tofu cubes to the skillet, stirring for 2 minutes.
Pour the sautéed mixture into the batter, then fold in sliced scallions and soy sauce.
Grease a baking dish with a little sesame oil and pour the batter into it, smoothing the top.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the surface is golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Remove from the oven, let it cool for 5 minutes, then cut into squares.
Serve warm with a drizzle of sesame oil and extra chili flakes if desired.
